ttft_definition: request start -> selector -> SSD pread -> cache reconstruction/scatter -> prompt prefill -> first output token argmax -> CUDA synchronize

field_semantics.ssd_payload_ratio_vs_full_visual_kv: actual visual K/V payload (plus mandatory separator sidecar) divided by Full visual K/V; excludes SparseVLM probe bytes
field_semantics.ssd_read_bytes: all bytes returned by actual os.pread calls
field_semantics.ssd_read_chunk_units: K/V/probe file-level chunk-equivalent units, not unique chunks
field_semantics.n_chunks_selected: Static+Diverse mean unique selected chunks per layer, excluding separator sidecar
